Non-injunction, a mere statement (of something already known);
 देशकालानामचोदनं प्रयोगे नित्यसमवायात्

(?) Probably a special messenger to report among other things,
 impending attacks from enemies; Sircar,

Ved. [नास्ति चोदना यस्य] Spontaneous, not influenced
